notes: This file is documentation/reference only. Nodes do not load regexes from the current working directory.
P2PKH and OP_RETURN/extended-token outputs use dedicated standard policy paths.
Generic Custom Script is admitted only when bytecode is structurally valid under AnalyzeScriptResources and does not execute reserved/disabled family opcodes.
Legacy NOVO/BSTY bridge opcodes remain byte-reserved but relay-disabled pending deterministic bridge redesign.
Canonical Multisig / Escrow V1 is exactly bare 2-of-3 with three strictly sorted compressed SEC1 public keys and OP_CHECKMULTISIG; other new multisig forms remain non-standard.

Canonical HTLC / Atomic Swap V1 is an exact 103-byte HASH160 + CHECKSIG claim branch and timestamp-domain CLTV + CHECKSIG refund branch; claim/refund public keys are role-specific, compressed, and distinct.
HTLC classification is exact. Other structurally safe custom scripts remain CUSTOM_SCRIPT and are not promoted to htlc_atomic_swap_v1 merely because they contain IF/HASH160/CLTV opcodes.

allowed_scripts.description: Canonical timestamp-domain Time Lock V1; relay also requires lockTime >= 500000000.
Canonical Hash Lock V1: OP_HASH160 <20-byte HASH160> OP_EQUAL.

Documentation shape only. Runtime parser additionally requires refundLockTime >= 500000000 and distinct compressed claim/refund SEC1 public keys. Claim remains valid after timeout until the UTXO is spent; timeout activates the refund branch.
Patch-18 deterministic Oracle Feed V1 using <= (a1) or >= (a2).
Documentation shape only. Runtime parser additionally requires the three compressed SEC1 encodings to be strictly lexicographically increasing (therefore unique).
Canonical f751 state anchor shared by activated stateful_kv_v1, voting_v1, and token_issuer_v1 families; registry determines family.

compiled_structural_families.description: Canonical V1 is parsed byte-for-byte against Wallet::createMagicLockScript shape; no regex or legacy marker search is used for new relay.
Supported deterministic bytecode only. OP_EXTERNALDATA, noncanonical OP_DATAFEED, OP_DELEGATECHECK, arbitrary state-domain opcodes, legacy bridge opcodes, and upgrade NOPs are non-standard.

relay_disabled: noncanonical bare OP_CHECKMULTISIG / OP_CHECKMULTISIGVERIFY scripts outside Multisig / Escrow V1
removed_legacy_regex_classes: opcode-prefix wildcard regexes for individual opcodes
token opcode byte searches that could match bytes inside pushed data
